name: Gearbox
text:
Add RealVisXL v1.1’s face model to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It fixes the synthetic face fidelity drop by replacing the generic face generator with a model trained on high-quality real faces, which directly addresses the core quality leak. The trade-off is a 5-8% increase in compute per face region, but that’s worth it because EXCAVA’s output will look more natural and less "AI-generated," which is the bottleneck we’re trying to crack.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL v1.1’s face model overfits to synthetic faces—its "realism" is just synthetic faces made sharper, not true real-face fidelity. A better alternative is testing RealVisXL v2’s face model first; if it still fails, fall back to a hybrid pipeline: use InstantX-ComfyUI’s upscaler only on non-face regions to avoid amplifying synthetic artifacts. Settle it with a controlled A/B test—measure face fidelity drop vs. compute cost, not just upscaler speed.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Test RealVisXL v2’s face model first on EXCAVA’s face regions—if fidelity drops, fallback to InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler only on non-face areas. Result: 0.5%+ quality gain or clear path to it. Owner: Gearbox.
